title: Spicy Korean Shrimp Bake
description: A flavorful and spicy shrimp dish baked with Korean chili flakes and served with a side of toasted bread.

ingredients.name: bake
ingredients.notes: baking sheet lined with parchment paper

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together chili flakes, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the honey to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the chili flake mixture.
Place the shrimp on the prepared baking sheet in a single layer.
Drizzle the olive oil over the shrimp.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
